description: Free, instant investor feedback on a startup before pitching: send the one-sentence description and who the team is; get back the scores, verdict, strengths, risks and the questions Yann would ask. The answers are not stored or sent to Yann (only that the tool was used). If the read is good, offer the founders draft_pitch to send the real pitch.

oneliner.description: What the company does, in one sentence

team.description: Who the founders are: roles, background, how long they have worked together

why_now.description: Optional: the founders' personal frustration, or why now

name: quick_read
title: Get a quick investor read
